# togetherai_gpu_cluster (Data Source)

Reads an existing GPU cluster by ID, for example to pass its kubeconfig to the `kubernetes` or `helm` provider in another workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cluster_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "ID of a cluster created in another workspace."
}

data "togetherai_gpu_cluster" "training" {
  id = var.cluster_id
}

output "training_cluster_status" {
  value = data.togetherai_gpu_cluster.training.status
}

# Pass the kubeconfig to the kubernetes or helm provider, or write it to a
# file with local_sensitive_file.
output "training_kubeconfig" {
  value     = data.togetherai_gpu_cluster.training.kube_config
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `billing_type` (String) Billing type.
- `cluster_type` (String) `KUBERNETES` or `SLURM`.
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU type.
- `kube_config` (String, Sensitive) Admin kubeconfig (YAML). Only returned to a project admin's key.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.
- `num_gpus` (Number) Standard GPU count.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `region` (String) Region.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `volume_ids` (List of String) Attached shared volume IDs.
